senses.sense_definition: Knives, forks, and spoons used for eating or serving food.

examples.text: Please help me set the table and put out the <w>silverware</w>.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Ножи, вилки и ложки, используемые для еды или сервировки стола.

target_lang_definitions.de: Messer, Gabeln und Löffel, die zum Essen oder Servieren von Speisen verwendet werden.
target_lang_definitions.fr: Couteaux, fourchettes et cuillères utilisés pour manger ou servir la nourriture.
target_lang_definitions.it: Coltelli, forchette e cucchiai usati per mangiare o servire il cibo.
target_lang_definitions.cs: Nože, vidličky a lžíce používané k jídlu nebo servírování pokrmů.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Yemek yerken veya servis yaparken kullanılan bıçak, çatal ve kaşıklar.
target_lang_definitions.es: Cuchillos, tenedores y cucharas utilizados para comer o servir alimentos.
target_lang_definitions.zh: 用于进餐或上菜的刀、叉和勺子。

nl.target_lang_sense_clarification: Algemene term voor eetgerei zoals messen, vorken en lepels.

senses.sense_definition: Trophies or awards won in sports competitions.

examples.text: The team is hungry for <w>silverware</w> after a long season of hard work.
